note: BLOCKED: Elevation is reachable (`copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com` and `elevation-tiles-prod.s3.amazonaws.com` answer 200), and so is 10 m Sentinel-2 (`sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com`). The blockers are (1) the place: our story happens on an invented street, and a 3D relief map has to show a real place, so placing the run there would present the fiction as geography; and (2) the scale: the event covers about 40 m, below what 30 m elevation and 10 m imagery can show, and the licence-clean mosaics the style uses for the wide shot answer `403`: `tiles.maps.eox.at` (Sentinel-2 cloudless), `gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov`.
short: Needs real terrain and imagery of a real place; the story's street is invented.
